# spotlight
> A tiny Rust overlay that lets AI agents mark screen regions with labels so users know where to click.
Canonical project page: https://projects.imba97.dev/projects/spotlight/
GitHub: https://github.com/imba97/spotlight
Status: documented candidate
Last verified: 2026-11-17
